role.basis: Registrar source review for this recipe; context, not a live-instance measurement.

summary.basis: Registrar source review for this recipe; context, not a live-instance measurement.
summary.value: Build OSPREY / BASTION: eighteen internal berths, six heavy-rated, with physical armored roof plates and gallery bulkheads. Added mass lowers speed.

tradeoffs.basis: Registrar design interpretation of the documented architecture; not a new capability.

assembled_dimensions.basis: X length, Y beam, Z height of all exported surface geometry, including attached equipment at its declared rest pose.

bounds_max.basis: Whole assembled surface bounds in ship coordinates.

bounds_min.basis: Whole assembled surface bounds in ship coordinates.

root_dimensions.basis: Root-part bounds only; not the whole assembled ship.

crew_and_passengers.basis: Not established for this exported configuration.

embarked_craft.basis: Not established for this exported configuration.

initial_fuel_and_magazines.basis: Initial fuel and magazine stock only; not all mission payload.

loaded.basis: Definition material includes modeled hardware; initial fuel/magazine stock is separate. Does not include crew, passengers, aircraft, escape capsules or other live payloads. Not a certified loaded mass.

material.basis: Modeled material, including modeled hardware; not certified dry or loaded mass.

departments.basis: Derived at normal initialization from occupied root span; exact assembled complement pending. See crew rules.

full_complement.basis: Derived at normal initialization from occupied root span; exact assembled complement pending. See crew rules.

minimum_watch.basis: Not established for this exported configuration.

passenger_places.basis: Derived at normal initialization from occupied root span; exact assembled complement pending. See crew rules.

people_currently_aboard.basis: This is an intact definition, not a populated live ship.

cruise_target.basis: Authored cruise target; not a measured speed, acceleration or endurance guarantee.

endurance.basis: Not established for this exported configuration.

jump_capability.basis: Base hashes identify composition; complete jump hardware, range, spool, fuel and operating constraints need a reviewed specification.

loaded_acceleration.basis: Not established for this exported configuration.

authored_rating.basis: Definition-level rated output; individual generators and consumers are in machinery. Not a guaranteed simultaneous power budget.

simultaneous_available_power.basis: Not established for this exported configuration.

damage_basis.value: WorkPerShot is the game contact-work budget. It is not explosive yield, joules or DPS.

mount_arcs.basis: Full traversable arcs, depression and obstruction limits are not exported. RailHalfArc is recorded separately where applicable.

armor_materials.basis: Not established for this exported configuration.

shield_operating_limits.basis: Not established for this exported configuration.

rated_range.basis: Authored sensor rating; not a guaranteed detection range.

suite_and_coverage.basis: The complete receiver, processing, communications and observation rules need a configuration-specific review.

exposure.basis: Internal/external classification requires a reviewed final assembly; a name or visible window is insufficient.

damaged_state_art.basis: Requires a real damaged-ship snapshot; intact art must not be painted into invented damage.

overlay.value: Material-derived tactical sections, not authored rooms or deck plans.

collar_and_service_interfaces.basis: Not established for this exported configuration.

compatibility.basis: A berth record or empty cavity does not certify all geometry, controllers, traffic, crew or service-store requirements.

service_contract.basis: Tender, carrier, rescue, refueling and yard services require separate finite operating contracts. Do not infer capability from visible openings.

fixed_architecture.basis: Registrar source review for this recipe; context, not a live-instance measurement.
fixed_architecture.value: Authored hull, load paths and role hardware. No generic interchangeable mount interface is established by this entry.

proposals.basis: Design proposals only; not implemented or certified compatible.
proposals.value: Alternative weapons or bay payloads need a reviewed physical compatibility and service contract.

supported.basis: Registrar source review for this recipe; context, not a live-instance measurement.
supported.value: Repair/replacement follows the exact installed definition. Separate research recipes are new manufactured fits, unless an explicit live upgrade says otherwise.
